evidence.notes: Integer and Date+Time overloads construct through the current user timezone for the modeled named-zone slice.
Local getters use the current user timezone while GMT variants stay UTC.
Modeled gaps roll forward by the transition gap; overlaps choose the earlier instant.
System.runAs current-user timezone returns a TimeZone object inside the modeled named-zone slice.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreDatetimeLocalTimezoneFixtureTest { @isTest static void localConstructionAndComponents() { System.runAs(new User(Id = '005-pacific-user', TimeZoneSidKey = 'America/Los_Angeles')) { TimeZone userZone = UserInfo.getTimeZone(); System.assertEquals('America/Los_Angeles', userZone.getID()); Datetime winterLocal = Datetime.newInstance(2024, 2, 29, 23, 5, 6); System.assertEquals('2024-03-01T07:05:06Z', winterLocal.formatGmt()); System.assertEquals('2024-02-29T23:05:06-08:00', winterLocal.format()); System.assertEquals('2024-02-29', winterLocal.date().format()); System.assertEquals('2024-03-01', winterLocal.dateGmt().format()); System.assertEquals(Time.newInstance(23, 5, 6, 0), winterLocal.time()); System.assertEquals(Time.newInstance(7, 5, 6, 0), winterLocal.timeGmt()); System.assertEquals(2024, winterLocal.year()); System.assertEquals(2, winterLocal.month()); System.assertEquals(29, winterLocal.day()); System.assertEquals(23, winterLocal.hour()); System.assertEquals(5, winterLocal.minute()); System.assertEquals(6, winterLocal.second()); System.assertEquals(2024, winterLocal.yearGmt()); System.assertEquals(3, winterLocal.monthGmt()); System.assertEquals(1, winterLocal.dayGmt()); System.assertEquals(7, winterLocal.hourGmt()); System.assertEquals(5, winterLocal.minuteGmt()); System.assertEquals(6, winterLocal.secondGmt()); Datetime fromDateTime = Datetime.newInstance(Date.newInstance(2024, 7, 1), Time.newInstance(5, 30, 0, 250)); System.assertEquals('2024-07-01T12:30:00.25Z', fromDateTime.formatGmt()); Datetime fromDateTimeGmt = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(Date.newInstance(2024, 7, 1), Time.newInstance(5, 30, 0, 250)); System.assertEquals('2024-07-01T05:30:00.25Z', fromDateTimeGmt.formatGmt()); Datetime gap = Datetime.newInstance(2024, 3, 10, 2, 30, 0); System.assertEquals('2024-03-10T10:30:00Z', gap.formatGmt()); System.assertEquals('2024-03-10T03:30:00-07:00', gap.format()); Datetime overlap = Datetime.newInstance(2024, 11, 3, 1, 30, 0); System.assertEquals('2024-11-03T08:30:00Z', overlap.formatGmt()); System.assertEquals('2024-11-03T01:30:00-07:00', overlap.format()); } } }
